sha256-fd-v1:aa88ab9411da79b09ed3225c6a9.description: Hunt Gorgus, the man who killed your father, across towns and monster-filled dungeons. This top-down RPG uses turn-based battles, equipment, and side quests to build the hero's strength.
sha256-fd-v1:aa88ab9411da79b09ed3225c6a9.title: Mad Paradox

sha256-fd-v1:aa94c40c87e34bba60da600e8a9.description: Choose or customize an adventurer, accept a quest from Mareen, and explore first-person dungeons for a target monster and magical item. Character statistics, equipment, and turn-based encounters shape each expedition.
sha256-fd-v1:aa94c40c87e34bba60da600e8a9.title: Case of Dungeons

sha256-fd-v1:aac98edd611c1c2ab6188037973.description: Enter BIAS, the dangerous complex beneath Beast City, after creatures disrupt the system the city depends on. The Screamer alternates first-person dungeon exploration with side-scrolling battles.
sha256-fd-v1:aac98edd611c1c2ab6188037973.title: The Screamer
